goal: Pursue substantial AdamW advantage by distinguishing fresh noisy batches from repeated passes, plus matched boundary expansion/refinement for every optimizer family.
diagnosis: Prior proxy was B=1, scalar squared loss, mostly stationary IID data, fixed beta2=.999 and zero decay. PPO transfer used a fixed LR and only two beta1 values. These are different optimization regimes, not an established transfer test.
model: Same 17-64-64-1 tanh MLP and initialization API as previous dense proxy. CUDA FP32, TF32 off; compiled updates and captured repeated-epoch rounds. No covariance or Fisher state.
moving_task: Eight equal segments interpolate through independently drawn nonlinear teachers; input mean shifts smoothly. No task ID, teacher, clean targets or noise variance enters optimizer. Targets/action rewards are noisy. Changes occur in full rounds so old PPO logprobs/advantages remain frozen within reuse epochs.
bandit: Gaussian scalar policy with fixed std=.5; noisy reward=-(action-teacher(context))^2+N(0,1); advantages use only same-round sampled reward minus round mean. Real signed clipped PPO score with clip=.2, no critic, no advantage normalization. New on-policy actions each round, common base noise across candidates. This is a policy-optimization proxy, NOT MuJoCo or a claim of PPO ranking validity.

equations.predictive: C=J_current^T(score_current-score_previous), scores on same current batch and objective; m'=beta*m+(1-beta)*g+beta*(1-beta^(t-1))*C; v tracks raw g^2.
equations.full: C=g(theta,current_batch)-g(theta_previous,current_batch), same first-moment mass and raw-gradient v.
equations.mars: h=g+gamma*beta*(1-beta^(t-1))/(1-beta)*C_full; m'=beta*m+(1-beta)*h; v tracks h^2; gamma=.1 or1. No clipping, no claim to reproduce every detail of published MARS.
equations.adamw: C=0; ordinary bias-corrected AdamW, beta2 tuned, decoupled decay excludes bias columns in every family. Adam is the decay=0 subset.
equations.round_clock: For new batch, use ordinary transport mass with t=fresh batch count. For reuse, m += (1-beta1^t)*C and v stays fixed. Bias correct using fresh count. C full/predictive/zero selects round_full/round_predictive/round_adamw. Weights and decay update each epoch. No batch target/teacher oracle enters optimizer. Epochs=1 reduces exactly to corresponding v4 algorithm.

selection: Identical 846 explicitly listed configurations per family; preserve v4 noisy-validation lock protocol. Adam is zero-decay subset. Treat boundary choices as unresolved, not optimum. All finite poor candidates retained in curves. Physical zero beta1/decay is not missing search space.
heldout: Independent train/validation/test RNG namespaces under seed1, no extra-seed claims. Noisy validation observed independently, clean risk diagnostic only. Held-out scoring after locks over saved selected trajectories; test scores never rerank configurations. Adaptive development rounds must be labelled, not disguised as untouched confirmation.
diagnostics: Retain16equal right-endpoint checkpoints; sustained risk is a quadrature estimate, not continuous measurement. Heldout deployment-gradient diagnostics at preupdate weights include clipping/reuse/same-batch-baseline discrepancy in bandit, not pure noise. No confidence acrosstrainingseeds. Save locked selected trajectories, prune only generated unselected grid tensors after all selected writes and scores complete.
promotion: Seek >=20% lower sustained held-out excess risk than independently tuned AdamW, no substantial regression in other regimes, and account for extra gradient evaluations/runtime. This is an experimental target, not a promised result. No RL promotion from one proxy win.

execution.culling: No short-horizon culling of a full comparative stream; nonfinite candidates invalidated visibly. No blind retries.

iteration_evidence.status: IID and drift completed; bandit only AdamW completed, predictive capture failed whole-round parity before training. No v4 bandit candidate result.
iteration_evidence.observations: Best v4 IID transport -34.17% clean heldout risk versus tuned AdamW; drift/reuse best -1.03%, all other gains <.4%. All v4 best beta2 choices at sampled endpoints; drift decay often upper .1.
iteration_evidence.hypothesis: Repeated EMA incorporation of the same noisy batch discounts historical information as though eight passes were eight independent observations; preserve estimator mass during reuse and transport to current weights instead.
iteration_evidence.search: All294originalconfigurations plus predeclared union of beta2/decay boundary extensions and LR/beta1 refinements; same configurations in everyfamily. This is adaptive same-task development, not untouched confirmation.

verification: v4 11 contracts passed in5856; initial two test failures from comparing cancellation-sensitive moments on independently evolved FP32/FP64 paths fixed by same-state local oracles, tolerances unchanged. v5 must additionally verify fresh-clock mass, exact within-batch full-gradient estimator-error preservation, epochs1 equivalence, and local-epoch capture audits plus exact replay.
